title: Wire packages/custom_lints/test/ into CI or a make target — the entire suite runs nowhere today
why: grep across .github/workflows/ci.yml, root Makefile, and learning_tracker/Makefile for 'packages/custom_lints' or 'custom_lints' turns up nothing except the path dependency declaration in learning_tracker/pubspec.yaml — no CI job and no make target ever sets working-directory to packages/custom_lints or runs `dart test` there. Since `dart run custom_lint` is separately broken (analyzer 8-vs-9, baselined), these 7 unit-test files (1449 lines) are the ONLY thing that could catch a logic bug in any of the 9 lint rules — and they never execute automatically. This audit's own F1a/F1b/F7 findings (barrel-name mismatch, missing whitelist directories, weak filename match) are exactly the class of bug this suite exists to catch but currently cannot, because nothing runs it.
recommendation: Add a `lint-rules-test` target to root or learning_tracker/Makefile (`cd packages/custom_lints && dart pub get && dart test`) and call it from ci.yml and from `make ci`/`make audit`.
acceptance_criteria: A committed make target runs `dart test` inside packages/custom_lints.
ci.yml invokes that target (or the equivalent working-directory step) on every PR.
Deliberately breaking one rule's whitelist logic makes CI fail via this path (manual smoke check).

corrections: pubspec.yaml quote spans lines 14-15; 'dev_dependencies:' is line 14 not 15 — trivial anchor offset, content accurate.
